verdict.rationale: Cross-merchant product discovery runs only through Store Sync and Agent Ready. Both are merchant-side, form-gated programs: merchants request access from PayPal's AI team, and Google must enable UCP. The discovering agents are partner platforms such as ChatGPT and Gemini, not a user's own agent calling a self-service search API. The Agent Toolkit's self-serve product tools (create_product, list_product) cover only the developer's own PayPal catalog, not searching across merchants, so no evidence shows a keyless or self-service cross-merchant search capability.
